mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 190, persistent inflation signals a hawkish monetary policy response, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 190, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above 2050 and 350000 respectively signal strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST > 2050 and RSAFS > 350000, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve maintains accommodative policy, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the regime effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates strengthening economic activity, supporting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 2050 thousand units, robust consumer spending signals positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 2050, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 3.5%), higher discount rates lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.5, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly job growth (PAYEMS) exceeds 200 thousand, a strong labor market may prompt monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 200, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
